SELECT order_status,
       CASE order_status
         WHEN 10 THEN '待支付'
         WHEN 20 THEN '已支付'
         WHEN 30 THEN '已发货'
         WHEN 40 THEN '已完成'
         WHEN 50 THEN '已取消'
         WHEN 60 THEN '已退款'
         ELSE '未知'
       END AS status_name,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status;

SELECT
  order_status AS 状态码,
  CASE order_status
    WHEN 10 THEN '待支付'
    WHEN 20 THEN '已支付'
    WHEN 30 THEN '已发货'
    WHEN 40 THEN '已完成'
    WHEN 50 THEN '已取消'
    WHEN 60 THEN '已退款'
    ELSE '未知'
  END AS 订单状态,
  COUNT(*) AS 订单笔数,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 2) AS 占比百分比
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status

SELECT channel AS 下单渠道,
       COUNT(*) AS 订单数,
       ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS 平均应付金额,
       ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS 应付金额合计
FROM orders
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY 平均应付金额 DESC;
SELECT channel AS 下单渠道, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS 平均应付金额, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS 应付金额合计 FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 平均应付金额 DESC

SELECT p.name AS 商品名称, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 件数
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 件数 DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT p.name AS 商品名称, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 总件数
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY 总件数 DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT
  c.name AS 分类名称,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS 平均评分,
  COUNT(*) AS 评价数,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS 商品数
FROM product_reviews r
JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 平均评分 DESC, 评价数 DESC

SELECT c.name AS 分类名称, ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 2) AS 平均评分, COUNT(pr.id) AS 评价条数
FROM product_reviews pr
JOIN products p ON pr.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 平均评分 DESC, 评价条数 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT method AS 支付方式,
       COUNT(*) AS 收款笔数,
       SUM(amount) AS 收款总金额
FROM payments
WHERE event_type = 'payment'
GROUP BY method
ORDER BY 收款总金额 DESC;

SELECT method AS 支付方式,
       COUNT(*) AS 收款笔数,
       SUM(amount) AS 收款总金额
FROM payments
WHERE event_type = 'payment'
  AND status = 'success'
GROUP BY method
ORDER BY 收款总金额 DESC

SELECT
  member_level,
  CASE member_level
    WHEN 0 THEN '普通会员'
    WHEN 1 THEN '银卡会员'
    WHEN 2 THEN '金卡会员'
    ELSE '未知'
  END AS level_name,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers), 1) AS pct
FROM customers
GROUP BY member_level
ORDER BY member_level;

SELECT CASE member_level WHEN 0 THEN '普通会员' WHEN 1 THEN '银卡会员' WHEN 2 THEN '金卡会员' ELSE CONCAT('未知等级(', member_level, ')') END AS 会员等级, member_level AS 等级代码, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM customers GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY member_level;

SELECT city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 客户数
FROM customers
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
ORDER BY 客户数 DESC

SELECT city AS 城市, COUNT(*) AS 客户数
FROM customers
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8
ORDER BY 客户数 DESC, 城市;

SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(oi.line_amount) AS total_line_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(*) AS item_line_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_line_amount DESC;

SELECT c.name AS 商品分类,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.line_amount), 2) AS 明细总金额,
       COUNT(oi.id) AS 明细条数
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 明细总金额 DESC

SELECT c.city AS 城市,
       COUNT(o.id) AS 有效订单数,
       SUM(o.total_amount) AS 应付总金额
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_status IN (20, 30, 40)
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY 应付总金额 DESC

SELECT c.city AS 城市, COUNT(o.id) AS 有效订单数, SUM(o.total_amount) AS 应付总金额
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_status IN (20, 30, 40)
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY 应付总金额 DESC

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS 成功收款总额,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS 成功退款总额,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS 净实收总额,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 收款笔数,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'refund' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 退款笔数
FROM payments
WHERE status = 'success'

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_payment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'refund' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_revenue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS payment_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'refund' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_cnt
FROM payments
WHERE status = 'success'

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 取消订单数,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.id) AS 关联明细行数,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS 关联支付记录数
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.order_status = 50

SELECT c.id AS 分类编号, c.name AS 分类名称, COUNT(p.id) AS 在售商品数
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 在售商品数 DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id AS 分类编号, c.name AS 分类名称, COUNT(p.id) AS 在售商品数
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id AND p.is_active = 1
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.sort_order
ORDER BY 在售商品数 DESC, c.sort_order ASC

SELECT c.customer_no AS 客户编号, c.name AS 客户名称
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_no

SELECT p.name AS 商品名称, r.rating AS 评分, r.content AS 评价内容, r.created_at AS 评价时间
FROM product_reviews r
JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.id
WHERE r.rating < 3
ORDER BY r.rating ASC, r.created_at DESC

SELECT p.name AS 商品名称, r.rating AS 评分, r.created_at AS 评价时间
FROM product_reviews r
JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.id
WHERE r.rating < 3
ORDER BY r.rating ASC, p.name ASC

SELECT c.city AS 城市,
       COUNT(o.id) AS 订单总笔数,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS 下单客户数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (20,30,40) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 有效订单数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (50,60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 取消退款订单数
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city LIKE '北京%'
GROUP BY c.city

SELECT c.city AS 城市,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS 北京客户数,
       COUNT(o.id) AS 订单总数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (50, 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 已取消退款订单数
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.city LIKE '%北京%'
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY 订单总数 DESC

SELECT p.sku, p.name
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN product_reviews r ON p.id = r.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
  AND r.id IS NULL
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT p.sku AS SKU, p.name AS 商品名称, p.stock AS 当前库存
FROM products p
WHERE p.is_active = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM product_reviews r WHERE r.product_id = p.id
  )
ORDER BY p.sku

SELECT o.order_no AS 订单号, c.name AS 客户名称, o.total_amount AS 应付金额
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_status = 60
ORDER BY o.order_no;

SELECT o.order_no AS 订单号, c.name AS 客户名称, o.total_amount AS 应付金额
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_status = 60
ORDER BY o.order_no;

SELECT o.order_no AS 订单号, p.amount AS 付款金额, p.occurred_at AS 付款时间
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE p.method = 'alipay'
  AND p.event_type = 'payment'
  AND p.status = 'success'
  AND p.amount > 1000
ORDER BY p.amount DESC

SELECT o.order_no AS 订单号, p.transaction_no AS 支付流水号, p.amount AS 付款金额, p.occurred_at AS 支付时间
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id
WHERE p.method = 'alipay'
  AND p.event_type = 'payment'
  AND p.status = 'success'
  AND p.amount > 1000
ORDER BY p.amount DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT DISTINCT p.sku AS 商品SKU, p.name AS 商品名称
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = 0
ORDER BY p.sku;

SELECT p.sku AS 商品SKU, p.name AS 商品名称, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS 涉及订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 累计销售件数, SUM(oi.line_amount) AS 历史销售金额
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.is_active = 0
GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name
ORDER BY 历史销售金额 DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_no AS 客户编号, c.name AS 客户名称
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.id
WHERE cat.name = '数码电器'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN (50, 60)
ORDER BY c.customer_no

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_no AS 客户编号, c.name AS 客户名称
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.id
WHERE cat.name = '数码电器'
  AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_no;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 上海客户总数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 正常账号数,
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 停用账号数
FROM customers
WHERE city LIKE '上海%';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE city LIKE '上海%';
SELECT id, sku, name, price, stock, listed_at FROM products WHERE is_active = 0 ORDER BY price DESC

SELECT name AS 商品名称, price AS 价格
FROM products
WHERE is_active = 0
ORDER BY price DESC;

SELECT sku AS SKU, name AS 商品名称, stock AS 当前库存, is_active AS 上架状态
FROM products
WHERE stock = 0
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT sku AS SKU, name AS 商品名称, stock AS 当前库存, is_active AS 上架状态
FROM products
WHERE stock = 0
ORDER BY sku;

SELECT name AS 商品名称, price AS 价格
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 3
SELECT name AS 商品名称, price AS 价格 FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, name AS 客户名称, email AS 邮箱
FROM customers
WHERE email IS NULL OR TRIM(email) = ''
ORDER BY customer_no;

SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, name AS 客户名称
FROM customers
WHERE email IS NULL OR TRIM(email) = ''
ORDER BY customer_no;

SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, name AS 客户名称, city AS 所在城市
FROM customers
WHERE is_active = 0
ORDER BY customer_no;
SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, name AS 客户名称, city AS 所在城市 FROM customers WHERE is_active = 0 ORDER BY customer_no;

SELECT name AS 商品名称, price AS 价格
FROM products
WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(attributes, '$.origin')) = '杭州'
ORDER BY price DESC;

SELECT name AS 商品名称, price AS 价格, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(attributes, '$.origin')) AS 产地, is_active AS 上架状态
FROM products
WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(attributes, '$.origin')) = '杭州'
ORDER BY price DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreplied_count FROM product_reviews WHERE merchant_reply IS NULL OR TRIM(merchant_reply) = '';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unreplied_reviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews) AS total_reviews FROM product_reviews WHERE merchant_reply IS NULL OR TRIM(merchant_reply) = '';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00'

SELECT channel AS 渠道,
       COUNT(*) AS 下单量,
       SUM(CASE WHEN order_status IN (50,60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 取消或退款单数,
       ROUND(SUM(total_amount),2) AS 订单金额合计
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at <  '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY 下单量 DESC

SELECT channel AS 渠道, COUNT(*) AS 订单数
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY 订单数 DESC;
SELECT order_no AS 订单号, created_at AS 下单时间 FROM orders WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT order_no AS 订单号, created_at AS 下单时间
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < '2027-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY order_month
ORDER BY order_month ASC;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数量
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY 月份 ASC

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payments
WHERE event_type = 'payment'
  AND status = 'success'
  AND occurred_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND occurred_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM payments
WHERE event_type = 'payment'
  AND status = 'success'
  AND occurred_at >= '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND occurred_at < '2026-10-01 00:00:00';

SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, registered_at AS 注册时间
FROM customers
WHERE registered_at >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
  AND registered_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY registered_at ASC
SELECT customer_no AS 客户编号, registered_at AS 注册时间 FROM customers WHERE registered_at >= '2025-12-01 00:00:00' AND registered_at < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' ORDER BY registered_at;

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') AS 月份,
       COUNT(*) AS 已取消订单数
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 50
  AND created_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND created_at < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY 月份 ASC;

SELECT m.month AS 月份, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS 已取消订单数
FROM (
  SELECT '2026-01' AS month UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-06'
) m
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cancelled_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_status = 50
    AND cancelled_at >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND cancelled_at <  '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cancelled_at, '%Y-%m')
) t ON m.month = t.month
ORDER BY m.month;
